purpose: WKU direction two research proposal primary source checks

sources.title: RASSAR: Room Accessibility and Safety Scanning in Augmented Reality
sources.verified: Title, authors and CHI 2024 attribution; mobile AR indoor accessibility and safety checking using LiDAR and computer vision.
sources.scope: Prior application work, not evidence of AnjuGuard performance.

sources.title: Q-Frame: Query-aware Frame Selection and Multi-Resolution Adaptation for Video-LLMs
sources.verified: Authors Zhang, Yang, Yin, Luo and Luan; accepted ICCV 2025; query-aware frame selection and multiple resolutions using text-image similarity.
sources.scope: Online prefix restriction is a proposed task adaptation; original offline video results are not an online baseline score. CVF HTML direct fetch returned 403; author arXiv record was available.

sources.title: AxiomVision: Accuracy-Guaranteed Adaptive Visual Model Selection for Perspective-Aware Video Analytics
sources.type: author paper v2 and author repository search result
sources.verified: Six named authors, accepted ACM MM 2024; edge-cloud model choice, continual online learning, perspective-aware selection and topology grouping.
sources.scope: Adaptation must account for exploration and changed task assumptions; no claim that original theoretical guarantee transfers to our application.

sources.title: LiveVLM: Efficient Online Video Understanding via Streaming-Oriented KV Cache and Retrieval
sources.type: author paper v2 and official repository
sources.verified: Accepted DAC 2026; DOI 10.1145/3770743.3804012; v2 revised 2026-04-23 uses Vision Sink Bucketing and Position-agnostic KV Retrieval.
sources.scope: Requires access to model KV state; not directly comparable to black-box API request costs. No v1 chunk-compression description reused.

sources.title: AnjuGuard local implementation
sources.verified: Read current source for normal/degraded video parameters, network/thermal/AR-rate transition, representative ranking and perceptual hash duplicate filtering; brightness/sharpness calculation; model/token/latency record fields.
sources.scope: Code inspection only. No real model, energy, device, performance or accuracy experiment executed.

research_status: Proposed protocol and hypotheses only; teacher approval, team, site permission, model budget and device conditions remain unconfirmed.
draft_constraints: Fixed model first; sending time and image resolution first; model routing optional later phase.
Causal prefix information only; pending results unavailable until their actual arrival time.
Quality gate covers event recall, critical classes, false reports and abstentions; failures remain in denominators.
Non-inferiority margin selected before test by task consequences and pilot information, never relaxed after observing test outcomes.
Site-based splits with related rooms, sessions and crops kept together; additional cross-session checks.
Cached responses cannot stand in for online latency; synthetic network tests separately labeled.
Energy claims require reliable energy measurement; battery percentage is not sufficient.
